pchickey opened PR #14822 from pchickey:fix_ghsa_9prg_main to bytecodealliance:main:

The prior implementation did not enforce that this was valid when splicing an existing body into a new response, which made it possible to perform response splitting attacks when responding to a non-spec-compliant client.

Fixes GHSA-9prg-84vf-g5fc
